implementation.name: T65
implementation.notes: license_id deliberately omitted. No LICENSE or COPYING file in the repository; the terms are in the per-file header, e.g. https://github.com/freecores/t65/blob/master/rtl/vhdl/T65.vhd -- Daniel Wallner's three-condition BSD-style notice permitting "use in source and synthezised forms". Substituting "synthesized" for BSD-3-Clause's "binary" means it does not match the SPDX BSD-3-Clause template, so no SPDX id is asserted. accuracy_id partial, from the header's Limitations section: "65C02 and 65C816 modes are incomplete" -- the core is a 65xx family model whose 65C02 mode the author flags as unfinished. 65C816 is not catalogued under data/chip/ and is not linked. freecores is a GitHub mirror of the original OpenCores project.
